name: Unnecessary Robot Timing
hint: A timed robot command has either a duration of zero or a blank duration that is interpreted as zero. The hardware is given no meaningful time for the requested movement, light, display, or sound action, so the command is ineffective or misleading.
instruction: Provide a meaningful positive duration, use an appropriate untimed command when available, or remove the ineffective action.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
@codeyA move forward at power (50) % for (0) secs :: motion
